withdrawn.reason: The milder-skew sensitivity run (zipf_a=0.8) was withdrawn on 2026-07-31. It executed no integrity guards, no driver-ceiling probe and no checksum pass, so it could not discriminate the hypothesis it was cited for -- that the aggressive skew does not inflate the result. Its figures, including the 1.527x closed-loop ratio, are unvalidated and must not be aggregated, quoted or compared against the primary run.
withdrawn.quotation_status: frozen -- the 1.527x above is quoted here only to identify WHICH figure was withdrawn. It is not a live claim, and no document in this repository may cite it as one.
